title: Brachiosaurus call (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by National Park Service; King L, Soltis J, Douglas-Hamilton I, Savage A, Vollrath F
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (wolf howl, humpback whale call and African elephant rumble, pitched down and layered). Sound design from 3 real recordings: "Wolf (NPS Sound Gallery)" 0.30–1.85 s, slowed to 0.55× speed (pitched down 45%); "Humpback Whale (NPS Sound Gallery)" 2.60–3.15 s, slowed to 0.7× speed (pitched down 30%), placed at 0.05 s; "Bee-Threat-Elicits-Alarm-Call-in-African-Elephants-pone.0010346.s003" 3.20–5.20 s, slowed to 0.85× speed (pitched down 15%), placed at 0.30 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 28 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
